Usage: astryx experimental icon new-set [options] <name>

[experimental] Start an icon set in your integration package

Arguments:
  name                         The set name, in lowercase kebab-case (outline)

Options:
  --dry-run                    Validate and show planned writes without changing files
  --from <module>              A module whose every icon component the set wraps (a package, a subpath, or a ./ path); run again to refresh
  --exclude <names>            With --from: comma-separated export names of the library that are not icons
  --variants <list>            Comma-separated variants the set supplies, such as outline,solid
  --default-variant <variant>  With --variants: the variant each icon's own export draws. When omitted: in a library whose export names encode looks, the look the icons draw (the library's usual default for a new set), which --variants must list; otherwise the set's current default, which --variants must list when the set has icons, else, on a set without icons, the first variant. A set with icons changes it only with --from, and only in a library whose export names encode looks
  --display-name <text>        The set's display name (the name in title case when omitted)
  --description <text>         The set's one-line description
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  the set is written or the dry run succeeds
  1  the name, options, package, or target files are invalid or conflict

Examples:
  # Start an icon set
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon new-set outline
  # Wrap a whole icon library
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon new-set outline --from @acme/glyph-library
  # Wrap a library with two variants
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon new-set heroicons --from @heroicons/react/24/outline --variants outline,solid --default-variant outline
  # Preview the files
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental icon new-set outline --dry-run --json

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/experimental-icon-new-set
